purpose: Provenance of the two Galaxy A05 reports in this directory beyond what the reports record (model, OS, ABI, pack identity): the first low-end Android device measured.

device.marketing_name: not reported by the device (ro.product.marketname empty); model code only (Galaxy A05 class)

access: Samsung Remote Test Lab reserved device, connected to adb through Samsung's Remote Debug Bridge (rdb, Intel binary under Rosetta on an Apple M4 Mac, adb over localhost:57492); ANDROID_SERIAL pinned the Gradle instrumentation run to this device

artifact_under_test.aar: io.github.ferhatguneri:kurmanci-android:0.1.1 downloaded from Maven Central by the vendor evaluation kit (CONSUMER_MODE=public), the published artifact of release 0.1.1
artifact_under_test.built_from: release commit 2c6b1537031414c1cca371ca6e5005152a8d415e by the android-v0.1.1 Maven Central workflow; the same bytes are recorded as android/kurmanci-android-0.1.1.aar in the provenance of the published bundle kurmanci-ku-Latn-0.1.1
artifact_under_test.consumer_app: integration/android/android-consumer, Debug, AGP 8.5.2 / Gradle 8.7, resolving the SDK from Maven Central
artifact_under_test.packs_from: the published bundle kurmanci-ku-Latn-0.1.1 (GitHub release v0.1.1), verified by scripts/vendor/evaluate.sh fetch --version 0.1.1 before the runs

harness_commit: 523526f14f7a71d8159efb00f18b72fbacb7b8d9 (the head of PR #77 at the time of the runs, 10:42 UTC on 2026-09-20, before its merge at 10:48 UTC); tree fed7c0989dd69d1d056c999773c10c8ee44c0fc6, identical to the tree of the merge commit 30c68a165ad7820ee063059105e2ac7c3d3339e1 = tag vendor-kit-0.1.1, which therefore reproduces the exact harness. scripts/android/device-benchmark.sh's measurement logic is unchanged since #74; the file last changed in #76 (2c6b153, SDK-version resolution through kurmanci-version.sh).
command: scripts/vendor/evaluate.sh android --version 0.1.1 --pack <pack> (scripts/android/device-benchmark.sh with CONSUMER_MODE=public; 200 iterations per operation, 5 cold loads, 300 stability rounds; JNI path from the instrumentation host)
loader_observation: 4 KB-page device, so the 16 KB AppCompat path does not apply; the logcat buffer captured after the second run no longer held the library load line, only the nativeloader namespace configuration for the consumer and test APKs
notes: experimental-full: whole-process RSS after the 300 query rounds (102.1 MB) is 16.9 MB lower than RSS after load (119.0 MB); 'RSS after load' is therefore the larger of two samples, not a steady state, and the cause of the decrease cannot be attributed from this benchmark (no empty-host measurement). The reviewed run's two samples were within 0.7 MB (76.8 to 77.4 MB). The harness's 'stable: true' asserts identical query results across rounds, not memory. Comparison with the SM-S948B rows of 2026-09-19 is cross-baseline: those measured the AAR built at 5ed81d9 (3f02e837...) with reviewed 485b9d70... (2,144 entries) and experimental-full 65764b14... (42,249 entries), not the published 0.1.1 bytes measured here.
